name: bakoma-revived-prototype
description: Experimental live LaTeX preview with token provenance and a LuaTeX checkpoint backend.

bakoma.checkpointMode.description: C++ compiler checkpoints: fork (default) or experimental internal undo snapshots. Internal snapshots improve warm edits but currently have slower large backward rollbacks.

bakoma.engine.description: cpp runs source mapping, compiler control and rendering in C++ (Ubuntu-22.04 WSL on Windows); stream is the Python comparison; snapshot finalizes PDF per edit; native uses full LuaLaTeX builds.

bakoma.mainFile.description: Main .tex path relative to the workspace, or absolute. Empty discovers the active document, its % !TEX root comment, main.tex, or prompts.

bakoma.previewMode.description: Auto retains incremental checkpoints for the supplied corpus and uses ordinary full builds for other projects. Full builds do not provide source navigation.

bakoma.latexCompiler.description: Compiler in Ubuntu-22.04 WSL on Windows. Auto reads % !TEX program, otherwise uses lualatex. Incremental mode requires lualatex.
